mapper.select: SELECT 'SOURCE_OWNER' AS kind,sv.source_version AS id,sv.original_sha256 AS sha256,s.classification AS classification FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} UNION ALL SELECT 'RIGHTS' AS kind,r.rights_revision AS id,r.content_sha256 AS sha256,r.classification AS classification FROM rights_revision r WHERE r.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND r.rights_revision=#{rightsRevision} UNION ALL SELECT 'MODEL' AS kind,m.model_config_revision AS id,m.content_sha256 AS sha256,m.classification AS classification FROM model_config_revision m WHERE m.model_config_revision=#{modelRevision} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.configuration_kind='MODEL' UNION ALL SELECT 'MODEL_DEFINITION' AS kind,d.model_config_revision AS id,d.content_sha256 AS sha256,d.classification AS classification FROM model_configuration_definition d JOIN model_config_revision m ON m.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND m.model_config_revision=d.model_config_revision WHERE d.model_config_revision=#{modelRevision} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.configuration_kind='MODEL' UNION ALL SELECT 'PROFILE' AS kind,p.profile_revision AS id,p.content_sha256 AS sha256,p.classification AS classification FROM project_profile_revision p WHERE p.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.profile_revision=#{profileRevision} ORDER BY kind
SELECT user_id FROM tenant_member WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT source_version FROM source_version WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,preparation_id,config_id,model_revision,profile_revision,source_id,source_version,rights_revision,source_sha256,original_object,original_authorization_sha256,snapshot_id,snapshot_sha256,parse_version,canonical_request,request_body_sha256,operation_request_sha256,idempotency_key,request_context,request_session,authorization_json,authorization_sha256,receipt_json,operation_id,audit_id,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification FROM model_enablement_policy_preparation WHERE preparation_id=#{preparationId} AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND configuration_kind='MODEL' AND business_purpose='MODEL_ENABLEMENT' AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND OCTET_LENGTH(original_object)<=8192 AND OCTET_LENGTH(canonical_request)<=8192 AND OCTET_LENGTH(authorization_json)<=4194304 AND OCTET_LENGTH(receipt_json)<=16384 LIMIT 2

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='MODEL-ENABLEMENT-POLICY-PREPARE' AND idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{creatorId} AND created_by=#{creatorId} AND operation_name='MODEL-ENABLEMENT-POLICY-PREPARE' AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND error_code IS NULL AND revision=1 AND updated_at=created_at AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND created_at=#{now} AND classification=#{classification}

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND subject_id=#{creatorId} AND created_by=#{creatorId} AND created_at=#{now} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action='model.enablement.policy_prepared' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{operationManifest} AND classification=#{classification}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{operationId} AND aggregate_id=#{preparationId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='model.enablement.policy_prepared' AND occurred_at=#{now}
